preserved_capabilities.semantic_readability: 0.94-1.00 from approximately L6 onward on the measured lexically separated family

source_evidence.interpretation: The highest-value training target is context-dependent semantic-to-episode-local-symbol binding/routing while preserving already-observed semantic readout, symbol writeout, and carrier-space binding capacity.

hypothesis: A factorial curriculum that forces the model to derive the output symbol from the actual episode-local S3 codebook across templates, codebook orders, lexical realizations, and query polarity can install the missing dynamic binding/routing computation more directly than retraining semantic recognition or applying one static steering direction.
strongest_counterhypothesis: The measured failure may reflect a deeper architecture/runtime limitation or a measurement/template artifact rather than a trainable binding deficiency; synthetic codebook SFT could improve surface mapping accuracy while leaving the intended internal mechanism absent or brittle OOD.
falsifiers: Matched pilot improves in-template accuracy but not frozen unseen-template/permutation/symbol-family transfer.
Class-symbol association or lexical cues predict targets above the episode-local mapping after counterbalancing.
Improvement disappears when codebook order, symbols, or query polarity are changed.
Post-FT causal tests show no new context-dependent routing mechanism despite behavioral gains.
Retention or authority-boundary regressions exceed the preregistered acceptance budget.

findings: The prior synthetic seed mainly teaches architecture protocol and does not directly target the newly measured semantic-to-codebook-symbol binding deficit.
The supplied Claude generator had a critical metadata-only permutation failure; the new generator reconstructs and validates the actual mapping from atom triplet plus S3 permutation.
Complete class-symbol counterbalancing must be exact within each generated block, not a loose relative-deviation threshold.
Literal ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN leakage is allowed only inside the episode-local CODEBOOK span for this generator version.
Query polarity is factorialized so a lexical target-class shortcut cannot solve all cases.
Four structurally distinct semantic families are balanced to attack the measured context-invariance failure.
Production generation must fail closed unless atom text, observed token_id, and token_count=1 are supplied externally; synthetic demo atoms mint no model/tokenizer fact.

self_discovered_validator_failure.failure: The first local validator version could accept a false s3_permutation metadata field when prompt and mapping metadata remained mutually consistent.
self_discovered_validator_failure.repair: Validator now deterministically reconstructs class->symbol mapping from atom_triplet plus s3_permutation and emits S3_PERMUTATION_NOT_CAUSAL on mismatch.

generator.factorization: 6 actual S3 mappings x 4 template families x 2 query polarities x 3 base semantic classes
generator.counterbalance: exact class-symbol equality within each selected three-atom block
generator.codebook_order: varied across all six orderings in deterministic seeded generation
generator.production_atom_source_expected: the 46 accepted orthogonalized contrast-centered atoms from the measured Claude XENO ABI package; rejected atom 'or' must not be admitted

open_gates: Materialize the measured 46-atom tokenizer-bound alphabet as a provenance-bound machine-readable input without inventing token IDs from the current ingest summary.
Run the generator on the real accepted atom set and pass the existing candidate-row gate plus family/provenance split linter.
Expand semantic lexical banks into split-isolated causal families; freeze validation/holdout families before mixture or checkpoint selection.
Add dedicated unseen-symbol and unseen-template holdouts using distinct provenance ancestry rather than sampling siblings across splits.
Measure class-symbol mutual information and non-codebook lexical predictors on emitted rows in addition to exact count balance.
Only then use the two pinned Qwen3.5-0.8B checkpoint candidates in the preregistered matched free/local pilot; do not select Base vs post-trained from source metadata alone.
After behavioral gains, require same-model causal tests before claiming J-Space mechanism installation.
next_exact_action: Recover or materialize the exact measured 46 accepted one-token atom identities from the Claude XENO package into a provenance-bound atom manifest, then generate the first real-atom TRAIN tranche with this v1 generator and run both row-level and family/provenance leakage gates before any model pilot.
